278304089.description:
German Hunter Style Tobacco Pipe
Munchen Edition, Modular Construction
Wood, Metal, and Horn, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A classic German "Jager" or hunter-style tobacco pipe, featuring the traditional modular multi-piece construction characteristic of Central European alpine regions. This specific piece is detailed with "Munchen" (Munich) engraved on the bowl, identifying it as a regional piece from the Bavarian capital. Designed for functionality in outdoor settings, these pipes feature long stems to cool the smoke and wind caps to protect the embers.
Modular design consisting of a polished wood bowl, bark-covered wooden stem section, and horn mouthpiece transition
Decorative hinged metal wind cap with ornate perforations and a secure latch mechanism
Accented with a traditional green cord featuring wooden toggle beads and a small decorative tassel
Engraved "Munchen" banner design on the side of the bowl
Condition:
The item is in used condition with visible charring and residue inside the bowl from previous use. The exterior wood finish retains a high gloss with minor surface handling marks. Metal components, including the bands and wind cap, show light tarnish and age-related patina. The modular joints fit securely. The green decorative cord is intact with some minor fraying to the tassel.

278279015.description:
Natural Stone & Mineral Specimen Lot - 6 Pieces
Mixed Geological Crystals and Carved Stone, Various Origins
A curated collection of natural geological specimens and carved stones. This diverse lot features a variety of textures, colors, and mineral compositions, ranging from raw crystalline structures to polished decorative art. These pieces represent a range of popular mineral types, making this an excellent starter set for collectors or a unique addition to home decor.
Items Included:
Petrified Wood Slab - Featuring natural wood grain textures with a identification label for Sequoia Roosevelt, WA.
Carved Buffalo Figurine - Polished stone with striking black dendritic-style inclusions on a neutral ground.
Blue Lace Agate Geode - Polished face showing delicate blue and white banding with a crystallized druzy center.
Pyrite Specimen - A bright, metallic cluster presented on a minimalist black metal display stand.
Tiger's Eye Point - A polished six-sided tower displaying characteristic chatoyancy in golden-brown hues.
Fluorite Bowl - A translucent carved specimen with rich green and purple zoning, suitable for small items or as a tea light holder.
Condition:
Overall condition is excellent for natural mineral specimens. Natural geological items may contain inherent cracks, pits, or irregular surfaces typical of earth-mined formations. Polished items show smooth surfaces with no significant chips or post-extraction damage. The pyrite stand is stable and functional. The petrified wood includes an original adhesive label.
